userStories.title: Implement Zero-Latency Capital Manager (Balance Cache)
userStories.description: Remove the synchronous `fetch_balance` call from the critical execution path. Cache balance in `MarketState` and update it asynchronously via `maintain_exchange_session` and after every trade.

userStories.title: Dynamic Regime Cortex (Trend vs Range)
userStories.description: Upgrade `analyze_infinity` to detect Market Regime based on ATR/Price ratio. If Low Volatility, use Mean Reversion logic. If High Volatility, use Trend Following logic.
